model_annotation: The plot illustrates the percentage of Co-occurrence Number (ACC) for various treatments. The x-axis is a logarithmic scale, ranging from approximately 1e1 to 1e3, with tick labels spaced by powers of 10. The y-axis is linear and ranges from approximately 0 to 65, with tick labels spaced by 5 units. The 'Base' line, represented by black dots, starts at approximately 40% and decreases to approximately 38% as the Co-occurrence Number increases. The 'FT' line, depicted with red triangles, begins at approximately 60% and decreases to approximately 55% as the Co-occurrence Number increases. The 'IKE' line, shown with magenta rhombuses, starts at approximately 50%, remains relatively constant at around 50% throughout the plotted range. The 'MEND' line, indicated by a red dashed line, commences at approximately 40% and increases to approximately 43% as the Co-occurrence Number increases. The 'MEMIT' line, represented by a green line with solid markers, begins at approximately 38% and rises to approximately 40% as the Co-occurrence Number increases. The 'ROME' line, depicted with a teal line with solid markers, starts at approximately 42% and decreases to approximately 40% as the Co-occurrence Number increases.
